title: Jacobian change of variables on Euclidean coordinate domains
statement: Use $\mathbf R,\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field]. Let $m\geq1$, let $U,V\subseteq\mathbf R^m$ be open, and let $\phi:U\to V$ be a $C^1$ diffeomorphism (a bijection such that $\phi$ and $\phi^{-1}$ are both $C^1$). For every complex-valued function $h$ on $V$, with the Lebesgue integrals interpreted as Bochner integrals (zero when the function is not integrable), one has $$\int_V h(y)\,dy=\int_U |\det(d\phi_x)|h(\phi(x))\,dx.$$ In particular the formula holds for every continuous compactly supported $h$ on $V$.
